integrity: The proof is symbolic and reconstructs the spectral partition, support projection, polar decomposition, kernel preservation, exact norm preservation, and beta_0 membership. The focal source was inspected in full at the definition and density theorem. Its proof already implies unstructured beta_0 density, so originality is claimed only for the stronger simultaneous preservation of polar factor, kernel, and norm. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The construction is an operator-norm approximation theorem on separable complex Hilbert space. It does not make the perturbation compact or finite rank, and it uses bounded Borel spectral calculus rather than requiring the approximating modulus to lie in the continuous functional calculus.
title: Fiberwise density of \(\beta_0(H)\) along fixed polar factors
